interpretation.inputs: Descriptive checks only; original units and missing values preserved. No labels or performance used.
interpretation.later_editions: Revision evidence is retained under dated PIT rules in legacy levels. New release descriptors freeze the first admissible edition of each period and require strictly earlier parents. Historical reconstruction can include dated contemporary reprints.
interpretation.expectation: No archived pre-release market consensus was present in the registered source data. Innovation is a forecast against prior observed releases.
interpretation.daily: Existing observation-window features are reused. Reconstructed quotes inherit the source vintage and date limitations; correction archives are incomplete.
interpretation.credit: TSF and loan regimes remain separate. TSF–M2 requires identical economic periods; new-loan seasonal change stays in the same definition.
interpretation.legacy: The sealed Z is preserved. Its trade YTD changes can cross calendar years and its source-age resets on same-period table reissues; Z* applies the economic year guard and first-documentation clock. Historical M+Z models using these columns should continue to be labeled legacy Z.
